description: Room Reverb: a stereo reverb that places each source and the listener in a rectangular room, computing the early reflections from that geometry and running a late tail behind them

params.text: Sets the size of the room, about 3 to 21 metres across
Changes the width against the depth of the room while keeping the floor area
Delays the wet signal behind the dry attack, 0 to 250ms
Sets how long the late tail takes to fall away, 0.25 to 8 seconds
Shortens the low and high decay against the middle
Sets how quickly the echoes merge into a dense, smooth tail
Adds slow movement to the late tail, from a little motion to chorusing
Sets the width of the wet signal: 0% mono, 100% natural, 150% extra wide
Turns from the early reflections through the inferred mix to the late tail
Removes bass from the wet signal, 20Hz to 1000Hz
Softens the top of the wet signal, 1000Hz to 20000Hz
Balances the dry input against the complete room response
Sets the output level after the mix, -60dB to 6dB
Feeds an octave-up copy of the signal through the late tail

inputs.text: The audio to place in the room; each channel of a polyphonic cable becomes its own source, up to eight of them
Moves the listener across the room; 10V covers the full width
Shifts the decay; 10V covers the whole range of the knob
Shifts the damping; 10V covers the whole range of the knob
Shifts the pre-delay; 10V covers the whole range of the knob
Moves the listener from the front of the room to the back; 10V covers the full depth
Shifts the early-to-late balance; 10V covers the whole range of the knob
Shifts the dry/wet mix; 10V covers the whole range of the knob

notes: the room drawing is a control in its own right: drag a numbered dot to move that source, drag the blue dot to move the listener, and double-click either to return it to its default
a source appears for each channel of the audio input, so with nothing patched there are no sources and only the dry path carries anything
the source positions and the listener position are reached only by dragging the room drawing and through the two listener CV inputs; no knob on the panel sets them
menu: Medium Hall (default) — loads the settings the module starts with
Small Room — loads a short, small-room setting
Superlush — loads a long, dense setting
Base FDN — runs the late tail on the original coefficient set
Optimized FDN — runs the late tail on the tuned coefficient set
